decision: CPU and role alone are not promoted to an attack classifier. Verify matched approved compute before proposing contextual features.
next_dataset_requirements: Verified task identity and typed fork lineage; never guessed PPID ancestry
CPU usage with verified clock alignment and process or job scope
Independent approved-job metadata recorded before execution; no scenario-name features
Normal high-load compilation/compression/maintenance controls plus dummy behavioral sequences, with matched role/CPU negative controls
Whole run and scenario family held out, no overlapping windows across splits
Normal-only threshold calibration before fresh family test; report DR, FPR, uncertainty, coverage and latency
Keep post-attack normal work in test; test delayed and repeated sequences without reset at label boundaries
promotion_gate: Fresh family evaluation must improve recall while satisfying normal-calibrated operating constraint. Tiny synthetic policy-label study does not satisfy this gate.
